comparison.objective: Seat four studs on edge in a layout jig against an end fence.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated large-part reorientation, slot alignment, squaring, and insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Per-stud credit for upright slot seating, with full credit when all four ends are within 2 mm of the fence for 1 s.
comparison.reason: Tests repeated rigid-part jig loading, not agitation-driven separation of mixed small bodies.
